overview_description.description: PointCheckout develops an online payment platform intended for loyalty and reward points. PointCheckout is a fintech payment platform that enables users to pay online using loyalty points and reward miles from banks, airlines, and telecom programs. The platform connects reward programs with a large merchant network, allowing customers to redeem points seamlessly at checkout or combine points with card payments. Founded in 2017 and based in Dubai, PointCheckout focuses on simplifying digital rewards redemption while helping merchants increase customer engagement and sales across the MENA region.
